submitted.rationale: EQE is essentially zero at and below the CoSb2O6 rutile composition (Sb 0.45 and 0.68). It turns on in the Sb-rich region, where CoSb2O6 is likely mixed with Sb oxide. Along that region, EQE rises from 0.027% at Sb 0.76 to a peak of 0.053% at Sb 0.82, then falls to 0.032% at Sb 0.87. Index 25 is the highest measured.
